summary: Review enterprise/procurement content for security, compliance, deployment, support and commercial claims that influence high-cost buying decisions.

must_inspect.why: Enterprise trust claims carry high proof burden because they affect vendor-risk decisions.
false_positive_guards: Do not call a certification false merely because proof is external; mark verification required.

must_inspect.why: Claims about onboarding, migration, support and deployment should expose material constraints.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand every operational detail on a marketing page when a clear linked source supplies it.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
